clue.text: Will finds time after trial to change name

parts.note: a trial is a test

indicators.note: to change says the letters of the word name are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes time after a court trial to change their name in their will.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a verb but is the legal document; 'after' sends the time letter to the very end.
explanation.definitionFit: A last will and testament is the legal document disposing of property after death, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Moves very quickly exuding drops

explanation.surface: Something hurtles along while oozing drops.
explanation.walkthrough: The two senses are pronounced differently, one rhyming with 'fares', one with 'fears'; 'exuding' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To tear along is to rush; drops of water from the eyes are crying drops, both senses spelt the same.

clue.text: A dramatic broadcast by the Queen acting after flattery gets to work

A is an abbreviation for acting, as in an acting officer

explanation.surface: Royal flattery gets a dramatic broadcast under way.
explanation.definitionFit: A serial drama broadcast on radio or television, originally sponsored by detergent makers.

clue.text: Slaughter is hesitant in opposition

indicators.note: slaughter suggests the words is and hesitant are hacked apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: A hesitant opposition politician dithers over slaughter.
explanation.definitionFit: An antithesis is a direct contrast or opposite, the state of being set against something.

clue.text: Upgrade in French hotel — one around the west end of Nice

parts.note: the French word for in is en

explanation.surface: A French hotel near Nice is upgraded by someone working on its western side.
explanation.walkthrough: ACE wraps N, the first letter of Nice, giving ANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: To upgrade something is to improve or raise its quality, which is what enhancing does.

clue.text: Huge birds getting caught

the ani is a tropical bird of the cuckoo family
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.definitionFit: Titanic means colossal, like the mythical Titans who were giants.

clue.text: It may appear after working with type

explanation.surface: Something is printed after typesetting work.
explanation.walkthrough: Working class is the phrase, so the word that may appear after working; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A class is a kind or category, so it means type; and it follows working in the social label for manual workers.

clue.text: Go on at motorists about parking

clue.text: A carriage brought back in pieces

parts.note: a trap is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

to miss something is to pass it by

clue.text: Drink with around nine grams of fat

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grams

explanation.surface: A drink served with a fatty snack of about nine grams.

explanation.definitionFit: Shortening is butter, lard or other fat used in baking to make pastry crumbly.

clue.text: Try speaking at this point

indicators.note: speaking says the word is heard, not seen

parts.note: a judge hears a case, which is to try it

clue.text: Suggest concealing identity of cow

parts.note: to intimate is to hint or suggest
ID is short for identity

clue.text: Penny about to give up lead

to cede is to give up or surrender

clue.text: Mischievous pet occupied by shimmering tinsel

shimmering suggests the letters of tinsel flicker into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Pestilent can mean annoying or troublesome, as a pest is, in its looser sense.

clue.text: Struggle for Tory leader after deception leads to downfall

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of Tory

parts.note: an end can be a downfall or ruin

clue.text: Old stock including clubs available at first for free

clue.text: Staying power shown by the first military dictator in South America

first picks the first letter of the

clue.text: Judge oddly neglected genre after piece on retired artist

clue.text: A supporter of mine gets shot crossing river

clue.text: Hotels in the centre of Barnsley

clue.text: Some ethnic headdresses discovered in an alcove

explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a shallow recess in a wall, the same thing as an alcove.

clue.text: Refusing to vote for German graduate over earlier disgrace at home

clue.text: Letters from Goethe reporting on that issue
